seo.description: Plan Tinghir: Todra Gorges, palm grove, ksar and desert route.
seo.og_description: Todra Gorges and oasis in Tinghir.

name: Tinghir
hero_subtitle: Gateway to the Todra Gorges — palm oasis, mudbrick ksour and the desert road.

info.airport_val: Road from Ouarzazate or desert route

overview.title: Welcome to Tinghir — oasis town at the foot of the Todra Gorges
overview.p1: Tinghir sits in a long palm oasis between the High Atlas and the Sahara road. It is the natural base for the Todra Gorges.
overview.p2: Explore the palmery, the old ksar, the Glaoui Kasbah and the road through the gorge toward Tamtatouchte.

places.title: Must-see places in Tinghir
places.subtitle: Todra Gorges, palm grove, ksar and villages.

todra.title: Todra Gorges
todra.desc: 300 m limestone walls and a narrow canyon with a clear river — Morocco's most dramatic gor

palmeraie.title: Tinghir Palmeraie
palmeraie.desc: A long ribbon of date palms, gardens and traditional irrigation along the Todra valley.

ksar.title: Ksar Tinghir
ksar.desc: Historic mudbrick fortified quarter with alleys, adobe towers and living Amazigh heritage.

glaoui.title: Glaoui Kasbah
glaoui.desc: Hilltop ruins with panoramic views over Tinghir and the palm grove.

tamtatouchte.title: Tamtatouchte
tamtatouchte.desc: Mountain village beyond the Todra Gorges — end of the canyon road and trailhead.

elhart.title: El Hart Pottery
elhart.desc: Major pottery centre of southern Morocco east of Tinghir — workshops and ceramics.

souk.title: Tinghir Souk
souk.desc: Lively weekly market and shopping streets — crafts, produce and local life.

tizgui.title: Tizgui Viewpoints
tizgui.desc: Village and viewpoints above the Todra approach — trails and wide gorge views.

itinerary.title: Suggested 2-day plan in Tinghir
itinerary.subtitle: Gorges first, then oasis and villages.

detailed_itinerary.day1_md: Leave Tinghir for Todra; walk the narrows.
detailed_itinerary.day1_ad: Viewpoints or continue up the canyon.
detailed_itinerary.day2_ed: Market streets or continue the desert route.

q1.question: How many days in Tinghir?
q1.answer: One full day for gorges and palmery; two nights if you prefer a slower pace.

q2.question: How far are the Todra Gorges?
q2.answer: About 15–20 minutes by road north of Tinghir.

q3.question: Good stop on the desert route?

q4.question: Best time?
q4.answer: Spring and autumn are most comfortable.

stays.title: Where to stay in Tinghir
stays.subtitle: Guesthouses and hotels near the palmery or on the road to the Todra Gorges.

card1.name: Hotels near Todra
card1.desc: Stay closer to the gorges for early walks in the canyon.

card2.name: Tinghir guesthouses
card2.desc: Central base for the palmery, ksar and souk.

card3.name: Palmeraie-edge stays
card3.desc: Rooms overlooking the date palms and valley.

card4.name: Simple hotels
card4.desc: Clean rooms for a one-night stop on the desert route.

eat.title: Where to eat in Tinghir
eat.subtitle: Tagines, grills and simple terraces with oasis or gorge views.

nomad.title: Gorge cafés
nomad.desc: Simple meals near the Todra narrows with cliff views.

jardin.title: Town restaurants
jardin.desc: Tagines and grills in Tinghir centre after a palmery walk.

fassia.title: Guesthouse tables
fassia.desc: Home-style dinners if you overnight in a local guesthouse.

moha.title: Port-style grills
moha.desc: Grilled meats and local dishes in casual town eateries.

bacha.title: Cafés & tea
bacha.desc: Mint tea and coffee stops between the souk and the palmery.

elfenn.title: Oasis terrace
elfenn.desc: A terrace restaurant with views over the palm grove and valley.

transport.title: Getting around
transport.desc: Grand taxis or a hired driver for the Todra Gorges. The palmery and ksar are walkable from central Tinghir.

bargain.title: Heat & timing
bargain.desc: Summer afternoons are very hot. Visit the gorges early morning or late afternoon.

water.title: Cash & water
water.desc: Carry cash for cafés and guides. Bring water on walks in the gorge and palmery.

atlas.title: Dades Gorges
atlas.desc: Another spectacular canyon west on the road toward Ouarzazate.

agafay.title: Merzouga dunes
agafay.desc: Continue east toward Erg Chebbi and the Sahara camps.

ouzoud.title: Todra Gorges
ouzoud.desc: The star canyon 15–20 minutes north of town — walls up to 300 m.

essaouira.title: Ouarzazate
essaouira.desc: Film studios and kasbahs about 2–3 hours west.
